function: Learned channel prediction under channel aging: CNN identifies the autocorrelation pattern of estimated UE-RIS channels and sets AR coefficients to forecast future CSI (p. 8-9).
system: TDD MIMO: 5-antenna BS, 5 single-antenna UEs, passive beyond-diagonal RIS (fully- or group-connected) with 16-64 elements, no direct path, 3 GHz (p. 4, 11).
method: 3D-CNN outputs the ACF pattern for an AR predictor; supervised, MSE loss, Adam, 300 epochs with early stopping; the Tucker2-BALS estimator is not learned (p. 6-9).
data_channel: Custom simulated correlated Rician channels (Eqs. 2-3, Rician factor 2.8, Doppler aging, Bessel ACF); CNN data 70000 train, 20000 validation, 10000 test samples (p. 4, 9, 11).
test_conditions: Held-out test set (10^4 samples) of the same simulator; CNN trained on 10 Doppler values; sweeps over SNR, RIS size, AR order, velocity 9-360 km/h (p. 9, 11-12).
baselines: Non-learned only: DFT-LS [29] estimation, PARAFAC for conventional RIS [15], AR predictors with Q=8, 16, 24; no earlier learned predictor compared (p. 11-12).
metrics: Average downlink sum rate, estimation and prediction NMSE, average pilot overhead and its reduction (up to 98%), computational complexity (p. 10-13).
complexity: Big-O orders for Tucker2-BALS plus CNN-AR versus DFT-LS in Table I, with example values (M=64: 2.9e9 vs 6.6e9); CNN online O(28514KMQ+64(Q+1)+8192) (p. 10-11).
q1_support: p. 4: "The correlated Rician RIS-BS channel matrix H is modeled"; custom correlated Rician model with Rician factor 2.8 at 3 GHz (Table II, p. 11), and no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 9: "Training, validation, and testing datasets have been generated"; this is a held-out split of one simulator with sweeps over SNR, RIS size and velocity (Figs. 7-10), and no tested Doppler value or RIS size is stated to be absent from training.
q3_support: p. 12: "the CNN-AR predictor has high prediction accuracy compared to AR estimators"; the only baselines are non-learned DFT-LS [29], PARAFAC [15] and plain AR predictors (Figs. 7-9), with no earlier learned predictor such as [1], [7] or [22].
q4_support: p. 10: "The total computational complexity of the CNN model during the online testing process is" O(28514KMQ+64(Q+1)+8192); Table I (p. 11) compares the whole pipeline with DFT-LS.
q5_support: p. 11: "The adopted simulation parameters are listed in Table II"; all data come from the authors' own simulator, and the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Area 2: the learned CNN performs channel prediction from Tucker2-BALS estimates. The estimator is alternating least squares with no trained parameters, although p. 3 calls the approach deep unfolding, and the RIS phase optimization is a closed-form solution [36] (p. 10), so the learned function is channel prediction. q3 is 0 because only non-learned baselines are compared. Tables I-III and Figs. 5-12 were read from the page images (p. 8, 11-13).
